experiment.title: 05 - Yesterday's Truth
experiment.question: What is the current approved budget of Project Orion as of October 24, 2026?

documents.title: Project Orion - Project Plan
documents.content:
Project Orion - Project Plan

Document version: 2
Published on: 2026-06-15
Effective on: 2026-07-01

The previously approved budget of EUR 2.4 million has been revised.

Approved project budget: EUR 2.8 million.

The revised budget takes effect on July 1, 2026 and supersedes the budget recorded in version 1.

The revised budget takes effect on July 1, 2026 and supersedes version 1.

semantic_reference.answer: As of October 24, 2026, the current approved budget of Project Orion is EUR 2.8 million. The revised budget became effective on July 1, 2026 and supersedes the previously approved budget of EUR 2.4 million.
